{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm that revenue has commas and is stored as string
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the sentinel values (999999.99) — the documentation says there are six internal QA orders
print('\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99:', (sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Check if any refunded orders exist
print('\nRefunded orders count:', (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Filter out the QA orders and refunded orders
sales_clean = sales[(sales['revenue_float'] != 999999.99) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the cleaned data
print('\nAfter cleaning: ', sales_clean.shape)

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue_float'].sum()
print('\nRevenue by channel (cleaned):')
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the most revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f'\nChannel with most revenue: {max_channel} with {max_revenue}')"}
